commands.command: set -e; EXPECTED=cf1ba40f30df2b6ee9ddd72d58a2bafe60852153; ACTUAL=$(git rev-parse HEAD); REMOTE=$(git ls-remote origin refs/heads/work/phase1-live-call-probes | awk '{print $1}'); echo expected=$EXPECTED actual=$ACTUAL remote=$REMOTE; test "$ACTUAL" = "$EXPECTED"; test "$REMOTE" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; state(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1; }; cleanup(){ python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }; trap cleanup EXIT; adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state | grep -qx device; test "$(state)" = "0"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 || true; PRE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys audio | sed -n '/- STREAM_VOICE_CALL:/,/Volume Group: AUDIO_STREAM_VOICE_CALL/p'); printf '%s
' "$PRE"; printf '%s
' "$PRE" | grep -q 'Muted: true'; printf '%s
' "$PRE" | grep -q 'streamVolume:0'; echo silent_voice_guard_pre_call=true; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" dial 510100100; ACTIVE=0; for i in $(seq 1 50); do ST=$(state); echo live_call_state=$ST; [ "$ST" = "2" ] && ACTIVE=1 && break; sleep 0.4; done; test "$ACTIVE" = "1"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 || true; VOICE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys audio | sed -n '/- STREAM_VOICE_CALL:/,/Volume Group: AUDIO_STREAM_VOICE_CALL/p'); DTMF=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys audio | sed -n '/- STREAM_DTMF/,/Volume Group: AUDIO_STREAM_DTMF/p'); printf '%s
' "$VOICE"; printf '%s
' "$DTMF"; printf '%s
' "$VOICE" | grep -q 'Muted: true'; printf '%s
' "$VOICE" | grep -q 'streamVolume:0'; printf '%s
' "$VOICE" | grep -q 'Devices: earpiece(1)'; printf '%s
' "$DTMF" | grep -q 'aliased to: STREAM_VOICE_CALL'; echo silent_audio_guard_active=true; echo dtmf_generation=none; sleep 2; APK=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge | cut -d: -f2 | head -n1); test -n "$APK"; OUT=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.DownlinkPipeProbe capture-live 1500"); printf '%s
' "$OUT"; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'probe=downlink-pipe-v3'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'audio_mode=2'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'session_started=true'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'route_guard=telephony_confirmed_by_session_start'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'bytes_read=48000'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'samples_read=24000'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'half_sample_carry=false'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'terminated_after_reader_close=true'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'terminal_failure_present=false'; NZ=$(printf '%s
' "$OUT" | sed -n 's/^non_zero_samples=//p' | tail -n1); PEAK=$(printf '%s
' "$OUT" | sed -n 's/^peak=//p' | tail -n1); RMS=$(printf '%s
' "$OUT" | sed -n 's/^rms=//p' | tail -n1); test -n "$NZ"; test "$NZ" -gt 0; test -n "$PEAK"; test "$PEAK" -gt 0; echo downlink_nonzero_samples=$NZ; echo downlink_peak=$PEAK; echo downlink_rms=$RMS; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup; sleep 1; test "$(state)" = "0"; trap - EXIT; echo phase2_downlink_live_silent_v3_ok=true
